metaDescription: Dog grooming near Calder Grove — a 6-minute drive to Keith's K9 Care in Hall Green, Wakefield WF4, just off the A636. One dog at a time. Book today.
lead: Five minutes off the A636, Keith's K9 Care is a calm, one-to-one home dog grooming salon — handy for the Calder Grove side of Crigglestone.
body: Calder Grove sits just off the Denby Dale Road, and we're a straightforward six-minute run across via the A636. It's an easy one for anyone on the Calder Grove or western side of Crigglestone — no trip into Wakefield centre, and easy parking right outside the salon on Castle Meadows.

Keith's K9 Care is a home salon, which for your dog means one thing above all: calm. One dog at a time, in a quiet, purpose-built room — no kennels, no shared dryers, no other dogs barking. It's the right environment for nervous dogs, puppies and seniors, and it means your dog has Keith's undivided attention from arrival to handover.

Keith is IPET-qualified and grooms every coat and breed — full grooms, puppy first grooms, bath and tidy, nail trims, de-matting and traditional hand stripping. Prices are published in full with breed examples, and confirmed in person before he starts, so you always know what you're paying for.

For a regular groom or a one-off tidy, getting your Calder Grove dog booked in is a quick call, WhatsApp or message. Keith likes a quick chat about your dog first to set aside the right amount of time.

faqs.q: How far is the salon from Calder Grove?
faqs.a: About 2 miles — a six-minute drive across via the A636 to Castle Meadows in Hall Green (WF4).

faqs.q: Is parking easy at the salon?
faqs.a: Yes — park right outside on Castle Meadows. No high-street traffic and no hunting for a space, unlike a town-centre groomer.

faqs.q: Do you do hand stripping for terriers and schnauzers?
faqs.a: Yes — Keith trained specifically in hand stripping. It keeps a wire coat's colour and texture, and it's the right choice for Border terriers, schnauzers and working cockers.
